audit.instrument_limitations: Projection outputs are retained actual shared-kernel calculations, not recomputed offline from the external weight matrix. Offline audit verifies native port hashes, operand selection, BF16 residual equations, typed state closure and full numerical/RGB futures. No independent mathematical forecast of edited images.
audit.scope: one selected block, known seed31 relation histories; image-row residual/attention/MLP factorial with fixed recipient post-block text; six new mixed operand combinations, observed native ports and shared projection kernels; not independent image forecasting

sealed_hypotheses.H-attention: Replacing image-row attention operands with base values moves the final latent toward base more than replacing MLP operands alone (projection010 < projection001).
sealed_hypotheses.H-controls: Native copy sham and self merge000 reproduce changed exactly; merge111 reconstructs native base image state at the block exit, while keeping changed text.
sealed_hypotheses.H-residual: The incoming residual also carries prior scene information; it need not be erased by one changed branch operand.

compact_custody.scope: local compact view and original image bytes verified; full arrays verified by the pinned separate CPU audit on the storage host

applicability.contrast: known red-cube/blue-sphere left/right histories with base stored conditioning
applicability.intervention: image-row R/A/M operands from base or changed; recipient changed post-block text fixed

computation_record.consumer: remaining native denoiser, three later original-prompt rereads, schedulers and VAE

counterexamples.counterexample: Attention replacement alone does not restore base ordering, contrary to the sealed categorical prediction.

countertrend.interpretation: Installing the base MLP operand moves these two partially restored futures back toward changed, not monotonically toward base.

counterexamples.interaction_scope: signed final-latent projection; downstream nonlinear consumer effect, not a discovered Boolean AND gate
